name: Shelf Life: Spire Drop Season 4
description: The fourth and most watched season of the reality format in which Tier 5 Spire residents are stripped of their augments, given a Tier 1 stipend of forty Quanta, and deposited in a monitored Shelf district for ten days. Season 4 became infamous when contestant Aurelio Nakashima-Voss genuinely could not comprehend that the hunger he was experiencing was not a production effect and required emergency extraction on day two. The remaining four contestants produced some of the most-discussed moments in M88 reality television history.
cultural_impact: Season 4's Nakashima-Voss extraction became a defining cultural image of Tier 5 disconnection from material reality, referenced in underground art, political writing, and Shelf graffiti for years afterward.
story_hooks: One of the Season 4 contestants never quite returned to their Spire life — they're now operating somewhere in Tier 2, and a family member is paying to find out what happened to them
A Shelf resident who was displaced during filming has been quietly building a legal case, and needs someone to recover the production's internal location-clearing documentation
The party discovers that the 'monitored district' used for Season 4 filming was chosen because it sits above an infrastructure asset that Vantablack needed civilians cleared from anyway
